facts.text: The resort sits on a verdant hillside above the Ionian Sea.
facts.excerpt: Perched on a verdant hillside above the crystal-clear Ionian Sea

facts.text: Angsana Corfu is Banyan Group's first property in Europe.
facts.excerpt: Angsana Corfu Resort & Spa is Banyan Group’s first property in Europe

facts.text: The resort pairs Greek hospitality with Asian influences across its rooms, suites and villas.
facts.excerpt: it pairs authentic Greek hospitality with Asian influences across elegant rooms, spacious suites, and Mediterranean villas with private pools

facts.text: The infinity pool blends with the sea, creating the illusion of swimming to the horizon.
facts.excerpt: seamlessly blends with the sea, creating the illusion of swimming all the way to the horizon

facts.text: The Sunrise Pool Bar serves cocktails and healthy snacks poolside and on a wooden deck over the water.
facts.excerpt: the Sunrise Pool Bar offers cocktails and healthy snacks both poolside and waterside on a wooden deck across the waters

facts.text: Each Ionian pool villa has its own private pool and expansive outdoor terrace.
facts.excerpt: each villa features its own private pool and expansive outdoor terrace

facts.text: Villa guests have exclusive access to the V-Lounge.
facts.excerpt: Exclusive access to the V-Lounge

facts.text: A dedicated Eclectic Villa Living team curates experiences for villa guests.
facts.excerpt: Dedicated Eclectic Villa Living team to curate unique experiences for you

facts.text: Villa guests can hire a personal chef to cook in the villa, such as The Corfiot Family Table experience.
facts.excerpt: we offer the option to hire a personal chef to prepare meals in the privacy of your villa, such as The Corfiot Family Table experience

facts.text: The resort has a private beach, Emerald Beach.
facts.excerpt: Experience an exclusive seaside escape at our private Emerald Beach.

facts.text: Spa treatments fuse Asian rituals with local organic ingredients, some grown in the hotel's rooftop garden.
facts.excerpt: Our Angsana Corfu Spa treatments fuse time-honoured rituals from Asia with organic, locally sourced ingredients such as flowers, herbs and fruits, some of which are grown in the hotel’s rooftop garden.

facts.text: Four of the spa treatment rooms have their own steam rooms and baths.
facts.excerpt: Treatment rooms offer exceptional views, with four featuring exclusive steam rooms and baths

facts.text: The spa offers a Rain Mist massage inspired by Thai waterfall treatments.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in our unique Rain Mist massage, inspired by waterfall treatments in Thailand

facts.text: Rangers' Club is the kids club for ages 4 to 11, with its own swimming pool, sandbox and games.
facts.excerpt: dedicated for ages 4 to 11 years old. The kids club features its own swimming pool, sandbox and games.

facts.text: Restaurants serve Greek and Corfiot specialities alongside North Asian cuisine, sushi and international dishes.
facts.excerpt: Greek and Corfiot specialities joined by North Asian cuisine, sushi, and international favourites

facts.text: The resort offers private luxury yacht tours around Corfu.
facts.excerpt: Experience Corfu's beauty with a private luxury yacht tour.

facts.text: Corfu Old Town, Achilleion Palace and the Temple of Artemis ruins are a few minutes' drive from the resort.
facts.excerpt: the UNESCO-recognised Old Town of Corfu, the majestic Achilleion Palace, and the ancient ruins of the Temple of Artemis. All are located just a few minutes' drive from the resort.

facts.text: Benitses Bay Seaview Grand Rooms have balcony views of the sea and Benitses Bay.
facts.excerpt: Breathtaking views of the Mediterranean Sea and picturesque Benitses Bay from the comfort of your balcony

facts.text: The fitness club has a gym and an outdoor yoga deck.
facts.excerpt: in our state-of-the-art gym, or on our outdoor yoga deck

facts.text: The resort is near Corfu International Airport.
facts.excerpt: The resort is also conveniently located near Corfu International Airport

facts.text: All outdoor food and drink outlets are subject to weather conditions.
facts.excerpt: All outdoor F&B outlets are subject to weather conditions

facts.text: During certain periods the villa guests' breakfast area and in-house experiences may not be available.
facts.excerpt: During certain periods, the dedicated breakfast area and in-house experiences may not be available.

facts.text: The Four Bedroom Pool Villa sits at the heart of the Angsana Corfu estate.
facts.excerpt: An imposing residence at the heart of the Angsana Corfu estate
